serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Somehow I managed to fool him, but it was a close call.
Nevertheless, I think he still doesn't trust me fully, so moving forward I need to be even more careful…
One thing keeps bothering me though…
Do I really want to do this?
Admin seems like an alright guy.
This whole mess DAK guy made wasn’t really his fault. Just like Big Daddy, he wants to help people in his own way.
I don’t know about this… {{wi}}AI-cracy he wants to make.
Is it a good idea? I don’t know, but looking at the world we are living in…{{wi}} could it really be worse than what we have right now? I’m not so sure…
I wish some dialogue could take place between Big Daddy and Admin, but I know that’s impossible. Their minds are set in place.
There’s also some truth to what DAK said.
As horrible as his actions are and how crazy he is, people much smarter than me tried to bring change by peaceful means for years in no vain…
The government is corrupt, the standard of living is constantly dropping…
Is it all hopeless? Maybe so.
I guess, in the end, it will ultimately be my choice.
Should I side with Admin, Big Daddy or maybe DAK?
That’s the first time in my life where my decision can actually change something. I can bring a change, but I can’t say I’m happy about it…
If my choice is bad, I will have to live with its burden for the rest of my life.
